description: This Java source file defines the class `PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks`, which implements resource limit checking functionalities for tenants by querying a Prometheus server. It includes methods to check connection limits and message/data volume limits, with support for different calculation modes and caching of metrics data.

classes.name: PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks
classes.description: This class provides methods to check resource limits such as connection count limits and message/data volume limits for tenants by querying a Prometheus server, with support for different periods and caching.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if the connection count limit for a tenant has been exceeded by querying Prometheus metrics.

methods.name: isMessageLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if the message/data volume limit for a tenant has been exceeded based on message payload size and configured limits, considering different period modes.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Performs an HTTP query to Prometheus with a given query string and returns the result as a future long value.

methods.name: extractLongValue
methods.description: Extracts a long value from a Prometheus JSON response.

methods.name: calculateDataVolume
methods.description: Calculates the allowed data volume in bytes based on effective date, target date, mode, and maximum bytes.

methods.name: calculateDataUsagePeriod
methods.description: Determines the data usage period (in days) based on effective date, target date, mode, and period days.

methods.name: getOrAddToCache
methods.description: Retrieves a value from cache or calculates and stores it if not present.

methods.name: addToCache
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with a specified key and timeout.
